definitions.short: a fountain , bowl or globe (all as round )
definitions.full: H1543. gullah גֻּלָּה noun feminine basin, bowl — ׳ג Zech 4:3 + 4:2 compare below; construct גֻּלַּת Eccl 12:6 ; plural absolute גֻּלֹּת Josh 15:19 (twice in verse) + 2t.; וֺֿת 2Chr 4:12 ; construct גֻּלֹּת ( וֺֿת ) 1Kin 7:41 ( ׳הַגּ Th, so || 2Chr 4:12 compare Be), 2 Chronicles 4:41 3 t.; — 1 basin (pool, well ?) ׳ג מַיִם Josh 15:19 = Judg 1:15 ; omit ׳מ Josh 15:19 (twice in verse) = Judg 1:15 (twice in verse) (probably old proper name, of a location , compare Di). 2 bowl , a. of lamp, i.e. oil-receptacle Zech 4:3 , also 4:2 , where גֻּלָּהּ ᵑ0 as if from [ גֹּל ]; read גֻּלָּה Brd Ges § 91 . 1, R. 2; (> Hi-St Bö § 734 b De on Psa 27:5 Sta § 347 c , who think גֻּלָּהּ = גֻּלָּתָהּ ); — so also Eccl 12:6 הַזָּהָב גֻּלַּת b. of bowl- or globe-shaped portion of capitals of the two pillars in temple 1Kin 7:41 (twice in verse); 7:42 2Chr 4:12 (twice in verse); 4:13 .
